passages.text: A mind that’s serene, clear and unclouded, kind to all creatures: that’s the path to attainment of divinity!”
passages.note: Inner serenity and kindness over outward ritual

passages.text: “Brahmin, take a mendicant who sees a sight with their eyes. If it’s pleasant they don’t hold on to it, and if it’s unpleasant they don’t dislike it. They live with mindfulness of the body established and a limitless heart.
passages.note: Equanimity: not grasping the pleasant or resisting the unpleasant
